original.statement: Between external-secrets 0.15.0 and 0.16.0 the required list for spec.provider.fake.data items in the external-secrets.io/v1beta1 SecretStore schema changed from [key] to [key,value] (the same diff shows the identical change for ClusterSecretStore), so objects that omit spec.provider.fake.data[].value are rejected.

decision.reason: [ev-210dbd3942ad] shows that in the secretstores.external-secrets.io CRD, the required list for spec.provider.fake.data items in the v1beta1 schema changed from ["key"] to ["key","value"] between 0.15.0 and 0.16.0. So spec.provider.fake.data[].value in SecretStore v1beta1 is now required. The diff is scoped to the v1beta1 version, so setting version is justified. Deterministic validators also confirmed both the subject and the now-required change type.
